title: World Bloom — Break Down the Wall — Episode1 The Wall

meta.Event Outline: Vivid BAD SQUAD continue their intensive training, set on surpassing RAD WEEKEND. But one day in the Street SEKAI, a new area suddenly appears: an unfamiliar plaza, in which stands a huge wall...

rows.Line: Live House
Backstage

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Alright.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Like I was saying on the way over, this live house is on the same level as Rodin, where you all performed the other day.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Not only that, some of the teams you're going to see are signed to major labels. Get ready for a tough battle.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
That being said...
I believe you all have what it takes to win now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, we will.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Like Akito said to the entire city, we're gonna surpass RAD WEEKEND during our next event. This is all for that.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Then, give it absolutely everything you've got. Leave nothing behind.

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Right!
Got it!

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: <Next up, we've got Vivid BAD SQUAD!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: There's our cue...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Alright, you guys, show them what you've got! I'll do the same when I go next!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! We're gonna give it everything we've got!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Then, let's go!

rows.Speaker: An, Kohane & Toya
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Okay!
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Whew!
Talk about an exhausting day!!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I'm tired too...
All the other teams were so good...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I'm really glad we still won.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I couldn't believe it when they couldn't decide on a winner and asked us to sing another song... But that might've been our best performance yet.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I still can't believe how good you guys have become. I mean, you went toe-to-toe with an amazing team like them.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You say that, but try not to forget that you also went all out today.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Well, I figure I at least need to match you guys for passion... Since I can't match your skill, and I need to do everything I can to catch back up to you after being out of action for so long.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, we'll be counting on you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, Dad, that reminds me.
About practice after this...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Yeah, sorry.
I completely forgot that I have to go meet with the owner of COL...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: You've all had a pretty taxing day, so why don't you all call it a day here?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Use this time to do whatever you like.
You can practice by yourselves, work on those tasks I assigned all of you or do something else.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay, got it!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Alright, just try not to push yourselves too hard.
se_walk_men_005_1

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay, now what?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I'd like to work on my task...
But my pitch today during the chorus is still bothering me. I think I'd like to practice that part first.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay!
What are you gonna do, Kotaro?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I'm gonna head back and practice on my own. My little brother's been asking me to come home early when I can.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Your little brother must love you very much. I hope you two get to spend a lot of time together today.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Me too! So, I'll see you guys tomorrow!
se_walk_men_005_2

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Then, I'll take a short break before practicing...
<Hey, you guys!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? That sounded like...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I had a feeling it was you, Len.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Oh, you're all here!
Are you guys free to talk right now?!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
S-Sure.
But why the hurry? What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <So, the thing is...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <SEKAI has a new area!>

rows.Speaker: An, Toya & Akito
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A new...area?
Street SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: There! Look!
se_run_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Whoa...! This is so cool!
It's like a big plaza!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
You're right...
This place is completely new...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's huge. And it just appeared overnight?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Over here, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hi, Rin!
Oh, everyone's with you!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, what's the deal with this place...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
We're still not sure either.
Luka just brought us over.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I see.
But how or why did just appear like this?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hmm... I can't say for sure...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But your feelings may have something to do with it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, our feelings created this new area? Is that actually possible...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: SEKAI was born out of your feelings, so it doesn't seem like too much of a stretch to say that strong feelings can cause it to transform.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Transform...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But our feelings haven't changed that much or anything...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Our goal's still the same.
To surpass RAD WEEKEND...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: True...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, but taking a look around may help us figure out what feelings went into this place being created. After all, those feelings should manifest in some way in SEKAI!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What feelings went into this place...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(The plaza's so big...
There's a lot of graffiti on the walls—)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Find something, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, um...
It's just that the wall of that big building over there seemed a little funny.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, it is a bit odd...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Most of it is covered in flyers and graffiti, but the middle is completely devoid of anything for some reason...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Almost like there's a hole in it.
But why...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, it is kinda weird, but we don't have enough information to work with right now...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, why don't we try searching for clues somewhere else?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I agree. We should get the lay of the land first... We can start with one of these alleyways.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh... Okay!
Alleyway

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Whoa!!
This place is totally different from the streets we're used to!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah.
It's like we're suddenly overseas...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, this resembles the streets of Boston.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It does?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes.
When I was little, my dad held a concert over there and I got to go with him. This is very similar to what I saw that time.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh...
Now that you mention it, one of the other alleys I saw from the plaza looked like a street in Mexico I saw in a book of photos when I was little.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then, does that mean we're standing in the middle of a collection of streets from around the world...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That may be significant.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It's so cool how we get to see all these different sights! Let's keep exploring, you guys!
se_run_men_001_2

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, Len, wait up!
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It isn't safe to rush like that, you two.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
They never change.

rows.Speaker: Len's Voice
rows.Line:
Huh?!
Wh-What is this thing?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
...?!
What happened?!

rows.Speaker: Rin's Voice
rows.Line: E-Everyone, come here!

rows.Speaker: Rin's Voice
rows.Line: There's a huge wall blocking the way!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Whoa...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I-It's so big...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
There's plenty of buildings around here...
But this wall's taller than all of them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
And it looks very sturdy.
No windows or passageways either. Almost like a castle wall.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
But why's this path blocked?
There's no way ahead.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hmm...
Wanna try finding a way around it?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes.
There were many ways out of the plaza, so one will surely take us around this.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Then, let's try that side alley over there.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I wasn't expecting to find another giant wall here...
se_run_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I just tried one of the other alleys, but it was also blocked by a wall!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Could it be that all these alleyways are blocked by this one wall?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, we won't be able to see what's on the other side? I was hoping to see if we could find out what feelings went into making this place...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Still, what's with this wall?
They don't seem natural at all.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I agree.
It's as if it suddenly sprang up to block our way.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Did this wall also come from our feelings?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I mean, it's pretty prominent.
Why else would it exist, you know?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right... Yes, that might be worth keeping in mind.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But what sort of feelings would lead to this wall being created...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If I recall correctly, it's common for walls to appear in a person's dreams when they're feeling stressed or pressured in some way.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I guess we might be feeling some pressure lately... We did say that we're going to surpass RAD WEEKEND no matter what.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm... Which means...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
This wall...
It represents how we feel about RAD WEEKEND...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, that is a distinct possibility.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It makes sense if you think how huge it is, like no one could ever even think to try getting over it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: These streets from around the world may also be relevant to that.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Remember what you said you're going to do after you surpass RAD WEEKEND?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh...!
Right...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We're gonna go beyond Aunt Nagi's dream. In other words...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We're gonna stand on top of the world...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I don't know for sure, but that's my guess.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: If we do manage to surpass RAD WEEKEND, then we'll be able to see even more of SEKAI on the other side of this wall?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah!
That's gotta be it!!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I'm starting to like this place.
All your dreams have a tangible shape here.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Alright!
Now that we know what kind of feelings helped produce this place, let's try exploring all these alleys!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, nice idea!
Strolling around streets from around the world is bound to be fun!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, we can visit all those streets and visualize what it'll be like when we take on the world!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Then, let's take a walk.
I do wanna go back and check out that last alley.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Me too.
I'm still curious about the one I spotted from the plaza earlier.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, there's also one that caught my eye...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm... Checking out all of them is gonna take pretty long, so why don't we split up and meet back in the plaza later?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sounds good. That way, we'll still be able to have practice.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then, let's give ourselves thirty minutes to explore and meet back in the plaza afterwards.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay!
